text:
alina: quick sync - ops keeps doing blind undos during quota storms. proposal: a small "sandbox tryout" that runs a cheap in-memory routing branch, returns a confidence score and a ledger entry id before applying any override.

rick: love the ledger idea. make it immutable and sequence-numbered so postmortems can reference a single canonical artifact. also include a cost cap so previews don't run wild.

thao: sandbox tryout should return: preview_id, confidence_score (0-1), estimated deltas (err_rate, p95, token_cost), top-3 reason codes. UI shows score + a brief human blurb.

ops-bot: CI: sandbox-tryout-runner -> staging queued

alina: API sketches (text only):
```
POST /v1/rollouts/{id}/sandbox-tryout
{ "sample_pct": 3, "max_cost_usd": 0.50 }
Response -> { "preview_id": "pv-01", "confidence": 0.82, "estimate": "err:-0.01 p95:-12% cost:+0.04" }

POST /v1/rollouts/{id}/apply-override
{ "preview_id": "pv-01", "actor": "rick", "reason_code": "operator:sandbox_approve", "ttl_secs": 900 }
```

rick: server rules: require confidence >= 0.7 OR operator explicit override with higher IAM role. enforce max concurrent sandboxes per-account (2) and per-route (1). auto-expire previews after 10m.

thao: ledger entry must snapshot: trace ids, compact sample requests (anonymized), error-class histogram, quota-context (window/tokens/throttle_pct) and the decision weights used by the routing engine. store ledger_id in audit logs.

audit-bot: note: ledger entries are immutable, retained default 180d.

alina: UI: a tiny "Try in sandbox" button next to the revert/undo action. after preview completes show: score badge, estimated deltas, and a small "why" link that opens the ledger. button disabled if safety checks fail with tooltip.

rick: safety checks: block if (err_delta > 0.05) OR (p95_increase_pct > 25%) OR (cost_estimate > max_cost). show clear block reason.

thao: add machine-readable fallback_reason codes to every fallback event: e.g., Fallback::Quota::Burst, Fallback::Mem::Evict, Fallback::Model::OOM. that'll help sandbox routing pick correct sim behavior.

ops-bot: ticket created: ENGOPS-9991 (sandbox tryout + audit ledger + preview confidence)

alina: telemetry team, please ensure preview runner emits a small metrics snapshot and a linkable ledger_id. also emit "preview_confidence" in logs so we can query over time.

rick: experiment plan: roll sandbox tryout to internal routes with low traffic for 2 weeks. measure: fraction of undos that reduce errors, and operator time-to-decision.

thao: security: only rollout:operator may apply-override; rollout:viewer can run sandbox tryout but cannot apply. preview results must not be surfaced to customer dashboards. log session id + IP on apply.

audit-bot: reminder: apply-override events will create an audit record referencing ledger_id and are retained 365d for incidents.

alina: next steps: thao to implement preview runner + ledger schema, rick to spec IAM role exceptions and max cost knob, i'll mock the small UI and write the experiment A/B.

rick: +1. one more: include a tiny "rollback impact preview" that shows which downstream routes/customers would see change (top-3) so support can triage.

thao: will add that as part of the estimate. okay i'll post an initial schema PR today. :rocket:
